quarterly_data.quarter: Jazz Pharmaceuticals press release: Jazz Pharmaceuticals Completes Acquisition of Actio (09-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Jazz completed its acquisition of Actio Biosciences on September 15, 2026; Actio is now a wholly-owned subsidiary. The release adds ABS-1230 study detail: in preclinical studies, ABS-1230, an orally available small molecule KCNT1 inhibitor, inhibited KCNT1 across all evaluable pathogenic mutations, which the company says indicates potential to treat all patients with KCNT1-related epilepsy; CEO Renee Gala called it a potential 'transformative, first-in-class therapy' (company claim).
quarterly_data.figure: acquisition completed September 15, 2026; preclinical KCNT1 inhibition across all evaluable pathogenic mutations
